description: This file defines an interface 'IPasswordHasher' for hashing passwords, including a method for hashing given a password and salt, and implements IDisposable.

classes.name: IPasswordHasher
classes.description: Interface for password hashing operations, providing a method to hash a password with a salt.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Asynchronous method to compute hash of the password with the provided salt, returning the hash as a byte array.
